 'pow': lambda p: -p[0]*tt**p[1]+p[2],

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values;A=df['A'].values;y=df['dA_dt'].values
edges=np.linspace(0.5,10,11)
bi=np.clip(np.digitize(t,edges)-1,0,9)
def f(p):
    n=p[0]; G=p[1:11]
    return -G[bi]*A**n
r=least_squares(lambda p:f(p)-y, np.r_[1.0,np.ones(10)*5])
print("n",r.x[0], "G",r.x[1:].round(3), "nmse",np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(y))
# and additive: -G(t) + H(t)*A^m
def g(p):
    m=p[0]; G=p[1:11]; H=p[11:21]
    return -G[bi]+H[bi]*A**m
r2=least_squares(lambda p:g(p)-y, np.r_[1.0,np.ones(10)*5,np.zeros(10)])
print("m",r2.x[0],"G",r2.x[1:11].round(3),"H",r2.x[11:].round(3),"nmse",np.mean(r2.fun**2)/np.var(y))
